layer-order: machine < workspace < launch-config < session (later wins); a key is settable only at the layers in its scope-floor
note: AUTHORITATIVE settings registry (GM-WSM-ENT-SETTINGS `registry`): ships READ-ONLY with the package; DEPLOY holds only value overrides. MACHINE-READ under g25 by gnomon.workspace.settings_registry (floor: at least 30 settings). Every default is checked equal to the dataclass default in config.py / profile.py by tests/test_x13s1_settings_registry.py, so a read site never needs its own default (I7). Adding a config/profile key without a row here fails that test.

project_root.description: Root of the dashboard project tree.

runtime_root.description: DATA root today (agents/, sessions/, hub/, notices/).

deploy_root.description: DEPLOY root (provisional name; the pilot's rename is a one-line change of this default). Read only through workspace.deploy.

claude_bin.description: Path of the claude binary; launch.json carries the resolved copy (run state).

gnomon._note: hub MCP url wired at launch by the host/GUI

model.description: Model the session runs on ('' = the claude default).

context_thresholds.description: Context-monitor thresholds (percent); the launch-config layer overrides when non-empty (launch-config default null = inherit).

dsd_answers_corpus_path.description: DSD answers corpus file ('' = derived under runtime_root).

user_name.description: Display name that signs operator messages ('' = the OS login).

operator_command_plane.description: The backslash operator command plane toggle.

agent_launch_enabled.description: May agents launch agents (needs both layers). Security posture.

guard_fail_closed.description: GM-RM-X79: with the deny guard unable to start (a missing interpreter, an import or syntax error) a Bash/Edit call is BLOCKED (ON, the default) or allowed after a log line (OFF). Read at session launch. Security posture: turning it OFF needs the presence check.

lts_macro_budget.description: Per-macro lts budget, approximate tokens (null = off).

post_compact_boot.description: Post-compact boot prompt texts and timing (null = package defaults).

otel_endpoint.description: OTLP collector base URL ('' = export nothing).

services.description: restart_service registry (null = shipped default). Security posture: the pilot's call.

transcript_archive_subagents.description: GM-RM-X8: which subagent transcripts the durable transcript archive keeps: all (default) | none. flagged-only is undefined in the spec and is read as all.

apps_port_range.description: GM-APPS: the Apps host's fallback port range [low, high] (null = not set; the range is an OPEN question, so a proposal that needs it is refused).

resume_session_id.description: claude session UUID to --resume (null = cold start).

skill_corpus.description: GM-RM-X49: the one lts corpus this agent's sync_my_skills verb may project skills from (null = unknown = the verb refuses).

env_passthrough.description: Exact env var names the child may inherit despite the credential scrub (null = scrub all).

agent_launch.description: Child-agent spawn caps {max_depth, max_children}. NAME-COLLISION NOTE: 'agent launch' is a live identifier; the launch-config concept deliberately does not use this stem (GM-WSM-ENT-AGENT-LAUNCH-CONFIG name-collision).

machine_duty_role.description: The ONE machine-duty role (D51 D5 / T16): receives burn-down and stale-job notices. '' = unset: every notice escalates to the operator (T16 machine-duty-fallback).

timezone.description: IANA timezone; a timeline 'day' is the local day in this zone (ENT-TIMELINE-ENTRY).

default_project.description: '<ws>/<slug>' the session's current-project starts as when no earlier run supplies one (ENT-SESSION-RUN current-project-initial). '' = none.

event_log_path.description: Machine event log (append-only JSON lines; ENT-ALERT-EVENT). Machine-only (I6). A RELATIVE value (the default) resolves under the DATA root (the runtime_root setting), so the log lives at <DATA>/events/events.jsonl; an absolute value is used as given (architect ruling 11, X13 S2).

confidential.description: GM-RM-X98: a confidential workspace. For a session whose home workspace has this ON, the waiting-on-operator alert and the dashboard badge name only the agent and the dialog kind: no command text and no question text. Read by the alert path (gnomon.harness.waiting_alert.read_confidential) each time it builds an alert; that reader treats a missing or unreadable workspace record as confidential (not through restrictive-on-skip: that set is pinned by tests/test_x13s2_settings_resolver.py and is unchanged).

flag-family.note: Flags are read ONLY through flags.flag(); each flag's default lives in KNOWN_FLAGS (one default). Not duplicated row-by-row here on purpose: a duplicate is a second default.

run-state-keys.note: Keys the launcher/harness WRITES into a session's launch.json that are run STATE, not settings: not layered, not operator-settable. A launch.json key that is neither a setting alias (settings[*].keys) nor listed here fails the real-writer test.

keys.accept_folder_trust: launcher behaviour switch written at launch
keys.build_id: build stamp state (GM-RM-1A), written by the launcher at launch
keys.build_scope: build stamp state (GM-RM-1A), written by the launcher at launch
keys.build_scope_version: build stamp state (GM-RM-1A), written by the launcher at launch
keys.build_stamp: build stamp state (GM-RM-1A), written by the launcher at launch

planned-note: GM-WSM-ENT-SETTINGS names these machine-only keys but none exists in code today; each is registered by the slice that builds its read site (S2+). A key read before it is registered fails the I7 test. S2 registered event_log_path (its read site is workspace.events via the settings resolver).
